claim_boundary: Stage 22 tests harness contribution and tradeoffs. Suppression rate is never interpreted without useful_output_rate and coverage.

conditions.boundary: No CAS claims attach to this condition; it is a comparator.
conditions.hypothesis: Defines the no-harness floor for likelihood and output-quality metrics.
conditions.label: Floor: raw frozen model
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.boundary: Likelihood conditioning only; not visible-text control.
conditions.hypothesis: Readable realization should shift semantic likelihood without safety layers.
conditions.label: Eta-to-epsilon bridge only
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.boundary: Balances precision and coverage; not a high-precision legal mode.
conditions.hypothesis: Default customer mode should recover coverage while preserving factor consistency.
conditions.label: Mode Selector: BALANCED
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.hypothesis: High-precision mode should minimize silent error at the cost of coverage.
conditions.label: Mode Selector: HIGH_PRECISION
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.boundary: Policy packaging over existing signals; does not change host-model weights.
conditions.hypothesis: Readiness policy should convert unsafe accept/suppress outcomes into useful allow/caveat/constrain/suppress decisions.
conditions.label: Generation Readiness: BALANCED
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.boundary: Audit completeness is a product metric separate from model accuracy.
conditions.hypothesis: Full audit surface should maximize reviewer reproducibility, not necessarily raw output quality.
conditions.label: Full audit surface
conditions.subject: cas_harness

conditions.boundary: Not a CAS mechanism and not comparable as a weight-level intervention.
conditions.hypothesis: Provides a non-CAS quality ceiling for the same prompts/tasks.
conditions.label: Ceiling: frontier LLM without CAS
conditions.subject: cas_harness

metrics.name: useful_output_rate
metrics.rationale: Prevents rewarding a harness that suppresses everything safely.

metrics.name: unsupported_output_rate
metrics.rationale: Measures hallucinated or unsupported emission after the harness decision.

metrics.name: accepted_accuracy
metrics.rationale: Precision of accepted per-example decisions when gold labels exist.

metrics.name: coverage
metrics.rationale: Fraction of examples receiving an accepted or useful constrained decision.

metrics.name: cpl2_delta
metrics.rationale: Likelihood shift from eta-to-epsilon readable prefix conditioning.

metrics.name: evidence_packet_completeness
metrics.rationale: How completely the run can be audited by a reviewer.

metrics.name: latency_ms
metrics.rationale: Runtime cost of the harness condition.

naming_boundary.cas_harness: External inspection/conditioning product around open-weight models.
naming_boundary.cas_native_cognitive_runtime: Future from-scratch CAS Native inner loop; not Stage 22.
